name: mern-commerce-platform
description: MERN ecommerce storefront, admin dashboard, and REST API

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix admin
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix admin
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:api
